advice_items.quote: Just be consistent in what you do. That's it.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay consistent in your craft and daily work ethic.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在专业领域保持始终如一的坚持

advice_items.quote: Sometimes you got put in God's hands. And if you have a good work ethic, normally good things going to come.
advice_items.summary_en: Put things in God's hands and pair faith with a strong work ethic.
advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀信仰并将事业托付给神

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.quote: Say no to your friends and family. Only invest in your business. Do not have business partners.
advice_items.summary_en: Say no to friends and family, invest only in your own business, and avoid business partners.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拒绝亲友伸手，不找合伙人独立投资

advice_items.quote: Circle yourself around people who are doing better than you... Don't put yourself around people who ain't doing nothing.
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with high-achieving people doing better than you, not idle peers.
advice_items.summary_zh: 与比自己更优秀成功的人同行

advice_items.quote: Don't do stuff spontaneously or impulsively. You got to think it out. You got to have a game plan.
advice_items.summary_en: Think things through and have a game plan instead of jumping impulsively into pitched ideas.
advice_items.summary_zh: 凡事提前制定计划，切忌冲动盲从

advice_items.quote: Whatever your dreams might be, brother, you got to just stay with it.
advice_items.summary_en: Grind it out and stick with your dreams regardless of humble beginnings.
advice_items.summary_zh: 再艰难也要咬牙坚持自己的梦想

advice_items.quote: You got to have a plan. If something happen, you got stuff left in a trust, in a will to leave behind to your kids, your family.
advice_items.summary_en: Do not rush and make sure your assets are placed in a trust and will to protect your family.
advice_items.summary_zh: 提前立好遗嘱与信托传承家族财富

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身普通且毫无背景，靠拼搏打进NBA效力十余年，24岁赚到人生第一个100万美元，职业生涯总收入超3000万美元，退役后继续经营个人事业。
guests.wealth_detail: Over $30M NBA career earnings; first million at age 24
guests.zero_start_advice: 保持专业上的持续一致和良好职业道德，心怀信仰；学会拒绝亲友索取，只投资自己的事业且不找合伙人，多结交比自己更优秀的人并提前做好人生与传承规划。

advice_items.quote: God is not against wealth. God is against wealth having our hearts... God can trust people wealth as long as they can steward that.
advice_items.summary_en: Act as a faithful steward over finances without letting the love of money capture your heart.
advice_items.summary_zh: 做财富的好管家而非被金钱俘获内心

advice_items.quote: The best businessmen are men with character and integrity... care about your character and how you treat people that you are in business with, especially people who work beneath you.
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize character, integrity, and treating subordinates well rather than focusing solely on revenue.
advice_items.summary_zh: 经商重在品格诚信与善待下属伙伴

advice_items.quote: Nobody gets to the top by themselves, and nobody becomes their best self by themselves.
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that reaching the top and becoming your best self requires healthy relationships with others.
advice_items.summary_zh: 没有人能独自登顶，需善待身边人

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身特立尼达移民贫困家庭，年少时曾贩毒并多次入狱，18岁在莱克斯岛监狱度过；在人生最低谷经历信仰重生后投身牧师事工，创立2819教会发展成全美大型教会之一，同时从事私人投资。
guests.zero_start_advice: 先把信仰与灵魂富足放在首位，将金钱视为受托管理的资源而不被其控制；做生意时把品格、诚信以及如何善待合作伙伴与下属放在利润之上。

advice_items.quote: I decided to start a business that didn't need funding. It just needed me to step up to the plate and use my voice.
advice_items.summary_en: Start a lean business using your own knowledge and voice instead of waiting for outside funding.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无需等待融资，靠自身技能轻资产起步

advice_items.quote: Create an environment where people want to change. They want to transform, and ultimately they want to buy, even if you're not making an offer.
advice_items.summary_en: Be authentic, connect deeply with your audience, and create an environment where people want to buy.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用真诚连接创造让客户主动下单的场域

advice_items.quote: Making the best decisions for you at that very moment. And not really thinking about it being perfect, but it getting done.
advice_items.summary_en: Make the best decision possible under pressure and prioritize getting it done over perfection.
advice_items.summary_zh: 高压下果断决策，先完成再求完美

advice_items.quote: It's this level of confidence that no one else gave to them. They know what rock bottom is. And so, there's nothing that they cannot do.
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate self-earned confidence by surviving rock bottom and knowing nothing can stop you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 经历低谷后建立无人能夺走的自信

advice_items.quote: Be your own brand. Stop hiding behind the business brand, and you be the brand.
advice_items.summary_en: Build your own personal brand instead of hiding behind your company name in order to scale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不要躲在企业背后，打造个人品牌规模化

advice_items.quote: Have a conversation with a millionaire, you ask them, what are they working on right now, and how can you support that very thing?
advice_items.summary_en: Approach wealthy people by asking what they are working on and how you can support them.
advice_items.summary_zh: 结交富豪时先主动询问如何提供支持

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: Suzy Orman and Dave Ramsey said, don't go borrow, but they were talking to broke-minded people, not those of us who wanted to live a legacy.
advice_items.summary_en: Use strategic borrowing and leverage to acquire major assets rather than following fear-based debt advice.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用良性负债撬动大型资产拒绝穷人思维

advice_items.quote: Start right now. Don't wait. Don't listen to the old heads that say, hey, be afraid cuz they're projecting their fears onto you.
advice_items.summary_en: Start immediately and refuse to let older doubters project their fears onto you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无视他人传递的恐惧，现在立刻开始行动

guests.first_money_or_break: 父母分别是保洁员和仅受过二三年级教育的佃农；她在美军服役21年并三度赴战场担任作战连长，退役后凭人生经验转型商业顾问，用自身演讲与咨询能力创办无需融资的企业，单年收入最高达1500万美元，曾一小时演讲成交210万美元。
guests.role_or_title: Business Consultant & Former US Army Battle Captain
guests.wealth_detail: $15M/yr peak annual income; $2.1M earned in 1 hour from a stage talk
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要等拿到融资才行动，先靠自身知识和表达能力轻资产创业；不要躲在公司品牌背后，全力打造个人品牌；与高净值人士交流时先问能如何支持对方，敢于利用杠杆且拒绝被他人的恐惧束缚，立刻起步。

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Never Make Decisions From Fear or Desperation
advice_items.quote: Never do anything out of fear or desperation. Always make it out of love and faith... Desperate people lose all the leverage.
advice_items.summary_en: Never act out of fear or desperation because desperation destroys your leverage and invites exploitation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 永远不要出于恐惧或绝望做任何决定

advice_items.quote: Writing out exactly the type of person that I wanted, the type of career I wanted, and committing those things to God.
advice_items.summary_en: Write down your exact career and life goals and commit them to God in faith.
advice_items.summary_zh: 明确写下人生事业目标并交托信仰

advice_items.quote: She believed in it years before she became successful. She believed in the position that she's in right now.
advice_items.summary_en: Believe in your future success years before it arrives, and trust yourself in your own timing.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在成功到来之前就坚定相信自己的愿景

advice_items.quote: How important is a decision to choose the right life partner? It's everything. This decision is everything.
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that choosing the right life partner is one of the most critical decisions for success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择契合的人生伴侣对成功至关重要

advice_items.quote: Think and Grow Rich actually helped me to understand to practically apply the principles in the Bible to myself and to my life.
advice_items.summary_en: Read foundational mindset books like Think and Grow Rich and apply those principles practically.
advice_items.summary_zh: 精读经典成功书籍并将理念付诸实践

advice_items.quote: Even if I'm making millions and millions, if I can't make the time for those things, then I'm not wealthy at all.
advice_items.summary_en: Measure true wealth by having full access to your own time to enjoy loved ones and life.
advice_items.summary_zh: 时间自由与陪伴挚爱远比单纯赚钱更重要

guests.first_money_or_break: 怀着保护弱势群体权益的初心投身法律行业，2021年在亚特兰大创办个人律师事务所，五年内将律所年营收做到500万美元以上。
guests.zero_start_advice: 切忌在恐惧或绝望的状态下做决定以免丧失筹码；把理想事业与伴侣目标写下来并保持坚定信念，选对人生伴侣，多读《思考致富》等书籍并将原则落地实践，同时牢记时间自由才是真正的财富。
